properties.name: Buckingham curated visitor boundary
properties.methodology: Morphological closing of the preserved official built-up-area geometry using a 200 metre outward and inward buffer. This fills internal omissions for connected parks, river corridors and visitor green spaces without applying a general outward town buffer.

project.boundarySource: Curated Buckingham visitor boundary derived from ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024)
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides audit completed 2026-08-09. The unchanged ONS 2024 built-up area is the active inclusion boundary. Historic England designations and public current OpenStreetMap visitor facilities were filtered point-in-polygon. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-09: 17 of 190 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Buckingham qualifies as a local detour through Buckingham Old Gaol and Buckingham Chantry Chapel. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: An old gaol, university townscape and riverside walks
townGuide.intro: Buckingham’s compact centre combines the distinctive Old Gaol with eighteenth-century streets, church and university buildings, while the Great Ouse and Chandos Park add a green circuit.
perfectFor: A polished small-town stop with enough history and walking to reward a purposeful visit.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Old Gaol, Market Hill and Chandos Park
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Begin at the Old Gaol, follow a Buxplore route through Market Hill and the old town, then return beside the Great Ouse through Chandos Park.
